findings.highlight: Only their tracks are barely visible
findings.evidenceJa: かろうじて衝突が判る程度
findings.governingReading: A human observer could at most barely perceive that collisions were occurring.
findings.explanation: The English invents visible tracks and shifts perception away from the impacts that define the pinball image.

findings.highlight: the difference between rising until she loses her speed, rather than falling
findings.evidenceJa: 勢いを失うまで昇り続けるか、勢いを失って落ちるかだけ
findings.governingReading: Saber can only keep rising until her momentum is spent, or lose it and fall.
findings.explanation: The malformed rather than construction erases the two-stage alternative and makes the aerial limit difficult to understand.

findings.governingReading: Saber resembles a spark bursting sharply from surface to surface.
findings.explanation: Firework enlarges and changes the image, losing the compact, instantaneous ricochet contrasted with Rider’s coiling snake.

findings.highlight: I will allow you comfort soon
findings.evidenceJa: もうじき楽にしてあげる
findings.governingReading: Rider coolly promises to put Saber out of her misery soon.
findings.explanation: Allow you comfort is unidiomatic and weakens a poised death threat into vague benevolence.

findings.highlight: Rider’s ideal position must await at that point.
findings.evidenceJa: ライダーにとって必殺の状況に違いない
findings.governingReading: Saber knows that the rooftop must contain a situation from which Rider expects a certain killing blow.
findings.explanation: Ideal position removes the lethal tactical conclusion and substitutes generic positional advantage.

findings.governingReading: Saber thinks of Shirou as that foolishly, obstinately straightforward Master.
findings.explanation: Honest removes the critical edge that explains both her exasperation and concern.
